_meta.purpose: Real published figures for SLATE vehicle use: annual distance driven, Mexico City car insurance, UK car finance rates.
_meta.conventions: Each figure has value, unit, source, period, sourceType ('primary' = the statistical body or regulator's own publication, read directly; 'secondary' = a report of it by someone else, or a commercial source). Unconfirmable figures are null and explained in 'uncertain'. Nothing here is an estimate made by the compiler.
_meta.verifiedHow: Primary figures marked 'readDirectly' were read from the source file itself (DfT NTS0901 ODS, BoE IADB CSV, FHWA VM-1 page, StatCan 53-223-X PDF, FCA annex PDF, CSO press statement, CONDUSEF press page). Others were seen only via search-result summaries and are flagged.

perVehicle_lightDutyShortWheelbase.note: FHWA Highway Statistics 2024, Table VM-1 (updated February 2026). Light duty short wheelbase = passenger cars and short pickups/SUVs/vans. Same table: light duty long wheelbase 10,707; motorcycles 2,401; all motor vehicles 11,071. Average fuel per LDV-SWB 423 gallons.

perDriverByAge.note: FHWA Office of Highway Policy Information, 'Average Annual Miles per Driver by Age Group'. The page carries no data year; it sits in the 'Our Nation's Highways 2000' section and is widely cited as current but is old (probably 1990s/2001 NPTS/NHTS-era survey data). Use for the age shape, not as a current level.

perCar_allCars.note: DfT National Travel Survey table NTS0901a, last updated 10 September 2026. England only (not GB) since 2013. Respondent-estimated annual mileage, household cars incl. company cars (96% private in 2025). Rounded to nearest 100 by DfT. Landing page: https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/nts09-vehicle-mileage-and-occupancy

perCar_byFuel_2025.note: Plug-in hybrid suppressed by DfT as low quality [u].

perPrivateCar.unit: km per private car per year
perPrivateCar.note: CSO Snapshot of Transport Statistics in Ireland 2025. Derived by CSO from NCT/CVRT odometer readings. The Transport Omnibus ended with the 2021 edition (13,436 km per private car in 2021, a COVID year; 16,352 in 2019).

perVehicle_allVehicles.unit: km per licensed vehicle per year

perVehicle_allVehicles.note: Statistics Canada, Canadian Vehicle Survey: Annual 2009 (cat. 53-223-X), highlights: 'Canadians drove their vehicles, on average, 16,249 kilometres during the year.' All on-road vehicles incl. trucks. The CVS was discontinued after 2009; no national successor series found. Driver-age breakdown exists in archived CANSIM table 405-0070 (not retrieved).

perLightVehicle.unit: km per light vehicle per year
perLightVehicle.note: NRCan 2009 Canadian Vehicle Survey Summary Report. NRCan server refused connection; figure seen only in search-result text of the NRCan page, which also gives 15,336 in another sentence. Range by province: Nova Scotia 17,427, British Columbia 12,892.

perCar.note: No official INEGI/SEMARNAT/CONUEE national vehicle-km per car series found. ITDP Mexico (https://mexico.itdp.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Importancia-de-la-reduccion-del-uso-del-auto.pdf) states Mexico has no official historical VKT statistics. Commercial figures (15,000-20,000 km/yr; ~23.1 km/day in CDMX ≈ 8,400 km/yr, miituo) are not official.

legalRequirementCDMX.value: Current civil-liability (responsabilidad civil) policy required for every motor vehicle
legalRequirementCDMX.period: Reglamento de Tránsito de la Ciudad de México, art. 46; fine figures as of 2025
legalRequirementCDMX.note: Fine for private vehicles: 20, 30 or 40 UMA (MXN 2,262.80-4,525.60 at the 2025 UMA of 113.14/day); cancelled if a valid policy is shown within 45 days. Art. 46 text not read from the official Gaceta.

federalMandatoryMinimumCover.period: Ley de Caminos, Puentes y Autotransporte Federal art. 63 Bis; phased in 2014-2019
federalMandatoryMinimumCover.note: CONDUSEF page (read) confirms the federal compulsory RC insurance, MXN 100,000 for injury and death from 2014, with property damage added from 2019. The MXN 50,000 property-damage minimum is from secondary sources (autofact, search summaries) and not read on CONDUSEF's page. Whether CDMX art. 46 imposes these same minimums was not confirmed in the regulation's text.

cheapestRCPolicyNational.note: Rastreator (2 Aug 2024) reporting CONDUSEF: cheapest RC-only car policy MXN 3,436 (Seguros Banorte). National, not CDMX-specific; reference-vehicle profile not stated in the report.

averageRCPremium_commercialQuotes.note: From Rastreator's own comparison-site quotes (published 1 Dec 2025), not CONDUSEF or AMIS. Same source: limitada 7,755.05; amplia 12,900.52; amplia plus 14,153.05. Its CDMX sample (35-year-old married woman, 2024 Chevrolet Aveo) ran MXN 3,033 (RC) to 13,092 (amplia plus).

averageAnnualPremiumAllPolicies.unit: MXN per insured vehicle per year
averageAnnualPremiumAllPolicies.note: AMIS publishes totals, not an average per policy. Total vehicle direct premiums 2024: MXN 193,217 million (residentes segment 118,102 million), per AMIS via https://revistamagazzine.com/proveedores/primas-de-seguro-vehicular-crecen-26-en-mexico-en-2024-amis/ (secondary). Insured units end-2025 ≈ 17.05 million per AMIS (search summary only, not read). A ratio of the two would be the compiler's derivation, mixing trucks with cars, so it is not given.

shareOfFleetInsuredCDMX.note: AMIS figure seen only in a search summary. National ≈ 30-35%.

boePersonalLoan10k_quoted.note: BoE series IUMHPTL: sterling personal loan, £10K, to households, NSA. The series named in the brief, IUMBV34, is in fact the 2-year fixed 75% LTV mortgage rate (4.92% Aug 2026), not a personal-loan rate.

boePersonalLoan5k_quoted.note: BoE series IUMBX67: sterling personal loan, £5K, to households.

boeCreditCard_quoted.note: BoE series IUMCCTL: representative credit card lending rate. Included for context.

motorFinanceAPR_newPCP.note: FCA CP25/27 Technical Annex 2: 'PCP is the most popular form of motor finance [on new vehicles] with an average APR of 5%'; weighted average APR in the new segment 5.9% in 2023; ~19% of new-car agreements 2019-2022 were 0% APR.

motorFinanceAPR_usedHP.note: Used segment: 'HP is the most popular form ... average APR of 12%'; weighted average APR in the used segment 13%; weighted average maximum 28%. Sub-prime subset average APR 33% (range reported 6%-76%).

motorFinanceAPR_2026.note: No 2026 average motor-finance APR found. The FLA publishes volumes and values, not APRs. The closest 2026 official series is the BoE £10K personal-loan quoted rate above.

uncertain: US per-driver-by-age table (FHWA onh00/bar8.htm) has no data year on the page; it is old survey data, likely 1990s/2001. Use for shape by age and sex, not as a current level.
No US per-driver-by-age figure from recent NHTS (2022) was retrieved.

Canada: no national average-km series after the 2009 Canadian Vehicle Survey was found. The NRCan light-vehicle figure 15,366 km (2009) was not read directly; the NRCan page gives 15,336 in another sentence.
Mexico: no official average km per car per year exists (INEGI, SEMARNAT and CONUEE publish none found). Left null.
Ireland: a 2024 per-private-car figure was not found (latest confirmed is 2023: 15,196 km).
Mexico: no published average annual premium per private car from AMIS or CONDUSEF; only market totals and commercial quote averages. Left null.

Mexico City art. 46 minimum cover amounts (MXN 100,000 persons / 50,000 property) are confirmed only for the federal compulsory insurance (the persons figure via CONDUSEF); applying them to CDMX rests on secondary sources.

No CDMX-specific CONDUSEF price for minimum RC cover confirmed; a search summary cited MXN 757.52-3,607.59 for RESBA standardized basic policies in CDMX, but that was not read at source and is omitted from the figures.

UK: no 2026 average car-finance APR is published by FLA or BoE; the FCA figures relate to 2023 lending. A search summary claimed a BoE effective rate on new personal loans of 9.86% in July 2026; it did not appear in the BoE releases read and is omitted.
